Book Your Consultation A Fresh Take on Aesthetic Care A New-Age Luxury Med Spa Serving the Greater Boston Area You know that effortless, put-together glow some people have? It’s not just good lighting—it’s expert aesthetic care. At Aida Medical Aesthetics, we specialize in treatments that enhance, not overpower, bringing out the best version of you. Led by Neda Hosseininia, Family Nurse Practitioner, our med spa blends cutting-edge science with an artistic touch, so your results are as natural as they are noticeable. Our services range from Botox® and dermal fillers for sculpted definition to microneedling and Medical Grade VI Peels for that radiant, just-left-vacation skin. And for those looking for a little more, we’re proud to be one of the few clinics in Massachusetts offering penile enhancement —bringing Botox to the bedroom for a confidence boost that goes beyond skin deep. We take your aesthetic goals personally. Every treatment is tailored to your unique features, lifestyle, and preferences—because looking good should never feel one-size-fits-all. Treatments That Work as Hard as You Do Great skin, sculpted features, and total confidence aren’t accidents—they’re the result of expert care. Our treatments go beyond Botox and fillers, offering PRF/ restoration and hyperhidrosis solutions to help you look and feel your best. Results-driven, customized, and designed to fit your lifestyle, we proudly offer the best aesthetic treatments in the Greater Boston area. Injectables No frozen faces here—just expertly placed injectables for natural, refreshed results. Our treatments include wrinkle-smoothing Botox , facial and body contouring with dermal fillers (neck, arms, calves), therapeutic Botox for Masseter, TMJ, migraines, Trap, and more. We also offer PRF rejuvenation and Lipodissolve (PCDC) fat-dissolving injections—all designed to enhance your features, not change them. View Services Wellness Our Brookline-based medically supervised program uses FDA-approved GLP-1 receptor agonists like Semaglutide or Tirzepatide to curb appetite and reduce cravings—combined with B12 and Lipo shots (also known as Skinny Shots) to support energy, enhance fat metabolism, and promote sustainable results. Also, we offer Testosterone Replacement Therapy (TRT) to improve energy, mood, sleep, libido, muscle mass, and sexual performance. Personalized plans help restore hormonal balance and optimize men’s health. View Services Skin Treatments Boost skin tone, texture, and glow with HydraFacial , Mermaid Facial , microneedling , PDRN (salmon DNA), PDO After Glo Facial , and chemical peels —safe for all skin types and designed to deliver radiant skin with minimal downtime. View Services Penile Enhancement Enhance confidence with discreet, private, non-surgical men’s treatments. Penile Botox relaxes the penis muscle to add length to the flaccid (non-erect) penis and helps with sensitivity, premature ejaculation, and mild erectile dysfunction. Penile Enhancement with FDA-approved dermal fillers adds girth, volume, and immediate cosmetic results—NO surgery or downtime and complete discretion.
